title: Andrew Blum (Trium Group Founder) — 'essential reading for any entrepreneur, CEO, or founder'
summary: Andrew Blum — Founder & Chairman of The Trium Group (CEO advisory) and General Partner of Trium Venture Partners — recaps hosting Eric at Trium's second annual CEO Salon in June, endorsing Incorruptible as an important argument for structural protection against financial gravity.
blockquote: Eric advances an important and timely argument: without structural protection, even the most mission-driven companies and CEOs will succumb to the corrupting influence of financial gravity. The book also points to the agency each of us has to rethink and transform the prevailing company-building paradigms. It's essential reading for any entrepreneur, CEO, or founder.
attribution_title: Founder & Chairman, The Trium Group; General Partner, Trium Venture Partners
